name: NRE 3125
title: Watershed Hydrology
description: Fundamental hydrologic processes, water balances, precipitation analyses, infiltration, soil water, evapotranspiration, open channel flow, discharge measurements, and analysis, flow frequencies, ground water-surface water interactions, runoff processes and prediction. Problem oriented course requiring use of computer spreadsheets.
requirement_description: Open to juniors or higher. Recommended preparation: NRE 2010.
